Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) from RNA-seq data

rna_gsea.Rd

Performs Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) using ranked gene lists derived from differential expression results generated by rna_compare().

Gene ranking can be based on moderated t-statistics or log2 fold-change. The function integrates MSigDB gene sets via msigdbr and performs enrichment using fgsea, supporting multiple organisms and gene ID types.

Annotation is performed automatically using organism-specific org.*.eg.db databases.

Usage

rna_gsea(
  project,
  top_n = 10,
  geneset_collection = "C5",
  geneset_subcollection = "GO:BP",
  ranking_method = c("stat", "log2fc"),
  padj_gsea = 0.05,
  heatmap_mode = c("adaptive", "NES_ordered", "split_direction"),
  plot_heatmap = TRUE,
  enrich_plot = FALSE,
  seed = NULL,
  save = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

rna_project object created by rna_project().

top_n

Integer. Number of top enriched pathways to retain (default: 10).

geneset_collection

Character. MSigDB collection (e.g., "C2", "C5").

geneset_subcollection

Character. Subcollection within MSigDB (e.g., "GO:BP", "CP:REACTOME").

ranking_method

Character. Method used for gene ranking: "stat" (t-statistic) or "log2fc".

padj_gsea

Numeric. Adjusted p-value cutoff for filtering enriched pathways (default: 0.05).

heatmap_mode

Character. Strategy for selecting pathways in the heatmap: "adaptive" (balanced), but keeping biological effect "NES_ordered" (order by NES) or "split_direction" (balanced up/down).

plot_heatmap

Logical. Whether to display a NES heatmap of enriched pathways.

enrich_plot

Logical. Whether to generate enrichment plots for top pathways.

seed

Optional integer used to set the random seed for reproducibility. If NULL, the existing random number generator state is used.

save

Logical. Whether to store results in the active rna_project.

Value

An object of class gsea_result containing:

ranking

Named numeric vector of ranked genes.

pathways

List of gene sets used in the analysis.

gsea_full

Full GSEA result table.

gsea_top

Filtered table of top enriched pathways.

enrich_plots

List of enrichment plots (if requested).

contrast

Comparison used for ranking.

params

List of analysis parameters.

Details

This function operates on results generated by rna_compare(), ensuring consistency between differential expression and enrichment analysis.

The selected comparison defines the gene ranking used in GSEA.

For zebrafish, GO collections (C5) are not available in MSigDB and are automatically replaced with Reactome pathways (C2:CP:REACTOME).

Common gene set configurations

The MSigDB database is organized into collections (e.g., "C2", "C5"), which may not be intuitive. Below are biologically meaningful configurations for common analysis goals:

General biology (Hallmark pathways)

  • Concise, non-redundant representation of major biological processes

  • Recommended as a starting point

  • geneset_collection = "H"

Classical pathways (Reactome, KEGG, BioCarta)

  • Detailed signaling and metabolic pathways

  • More granular but also more redundant

  • geneset_collection = "C2"

  • geneset_subcollection = "CP"

Reactome pathways (highly curated)

  • Structured, hierarchical pathway knowledgebase

  • Good balance between detail and interpretability

  • geneset_collection = "C2"

  • geneset_subcollection = "CP:REACTOME"

Gene Ontology (GO)

  • Broad functional annotation (can be redundant)

  • geneset_collection = "C5"

  • Subcollections:

    • "GO:BP" – biological processes

    • "GO:MF" – molecular functions

    • "GO:CC" – cellular components

Cell type signatures

  • Gene sets representing specific cell populations

  • Useful for inferring cellular composition or activation

  • geneset_collection = "C8"

Immunologic signatures (C7)

  • Immunologic gene sets (stimuli, cell states, perturbations)

  • Particularly useful in infection, vaccination, and inflammation studies

  • geneset_collection = "C7"

Oncogenic signatures

  • Gene sets derived from oncogenic pathway perturbations

  • Useful for cancer-related analyses

  • geneset_collection = "C6"

Tip: Choosing a collection:

  • Use Hallmark ("H") for a clean global signal

  • Use C2/Reactome for pathway-level interpretation

  • Use GO (C5) for hypothesis generation

  • Use C7/C8 when biological context (immune/cell types) is central

Interpretation: Positive normalized enrichment scores (NES) indicate pathways enriched in the test condition, while negative NES values indicate enrichment in the reference condition.

Gene ranking

  • stat: prioritizes genes with strong effect size and low variance.

  • log2fc: emphasizes magnitude of change.

Visualization

  • Enrichment plots show running enrichment score for individual pathways.

  • Heatmaps summarize normalized enrichment scores (NES).

Pipeline context

This function is typically used after rna_normalize() and before downstream analyses such as rna_compare(), or clustering.

See also

fgseaMultilevel, msigdbr, rna_compare

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Using last comparison
rna_gsea(project = my_project)

# Using a specific comparison
rna_gsea(my_project,
         contrast = "treated_vs_control")
} # }
